name: cc-pulse
description: Animated usage meter above the prompt: context window, rate limits, cost, and a live prompt-cache expiry countdown

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto infers 5m or 1h from the environment and observed cache hits

warnBeforeExpiry.title: Toast one minute before the cache expires
warnBeforeExpiry.description: Shows a toast once per idle period when the prompt cache has 60 seconds left

keepWarm.title: Start sessions with keep-warm on
keepWarm.description: Off: the band's 保溫 button turns keep-warm on for a session. On: every session starts with it on. Keep-warm sends one tiny request about 30 seconds before the cache expires so its TTL starts over

keepWarmMax.title: Keep-warm requests per idle stretch
keepWarmMax.description: How many times keep-warm may extend the cache before it lets it lapse; your next prompt resets the count
